messages:
Maya P: Heads-up — large enterprise customer just asked for 'model pinning' so their ML infra always serves a specific model revision. They want both an API flag and a Console toggle. Quick take: API-first then Console later? :thinking:
Noah (PM): They emphasized auditability and easy handoffs to non-dev ops. Console would help adoption across product teams, but API gives fastest delivery.
Sam (Eng): Engineering cost: API flag ~4 dev-weeks (endpoint + auth + tests + SDK), Console toggle ~6-8 dev-weeks (UI, backend, perms, e2e). Ops + infra ~1 wk for both for rollout gating.
Lina (Design): Console complexity also needs guidance flows (who can pin, what happens to traffic) — that's another +2 weeks for UX and copy.
Noah (PM): Can we run a quick RICE-style scoring? Quick draft below — please comment.
Sam (Eng): paste: ```
RICE estimate (rough):
- API flag: Reach=6 (applies to many ORGs), Impact=7 (reduces friction for devs), Confidence=70, Effort=4w => R=(6*7*0.7)/4=7.35
- Console toggle: Reach=4, Impact=6, Confidence=60, Effort=8w => R=(4*6*0.6)/8=1.8
```
Maya P: That math aligns with my instincts. API-first yields much higher RICE. But launch criteria matter: we should define what 'done' means for API-only launch so support/CS don't get burned.
Noah (PM): Proposed launch criteria for API-first: 1) stable API with model_pin param (+ SDK updates), 2) API changelog and example playbook, 3) RBAC behavior documented, 4) integration test with one pilot customer, 5) rollback policy + metrics. Agree?
Sam (Eng): Agree. Also need a canary gate: rollout to pilot org, monitor latency/cost delta for 48h, auto-fallback if token errors >0.5%. Ops-bot: noted.
Lina (Design): For Console follow-up, proposal: surface usage patterns (who pinned, last change), safety guardrails, and a guided update flow. That can be an accessible secondary sprint.
Noah (PM): Risk notes: Console-only later could cause some non-dev teams to delay adoption. Mitigation: ship a simple README + one-click SDK snippet in Console where we plan to add toggle later.
Maya P: Customer impact timeline? They need it in ~6 weeks. API-first fits timeline (4w eng + 1w infra + 1w QA/pilot). Console won't make that window.
Sam (Eng): Implementation detail: prefer a declarative header `X-Redwood-Model-Pin: model@rev` + body param. Keeps routing simple. SDKs wrap it.
Noah (PM): Decision: ship API-first, include Console 'pre-commit' placeholder that links to docs and an uptake plan; aim Console toggle in Q2 sprint 5. Anyone object?
Lina (Design): No objections. Will prep Console mocks in parallel so backend can anticipate fields.
Maya P: OK — I'll draft a spec with the RICE snippet, launch criteria, rollout plan, and assignees. Action items: @Sam own API, @Lina do Console mocks, @Noah coordinate pilot. :thumbsup:
Sam (Eng): Assigned.
Ops-bot: Creating rollout ticket RDW-3421 and canary monitor RDW-MON-78.
Noah (PM): Thanks — will add to roadmap and notify sales/CS about the timeline.
Maya P: End thread — will share spec link in #product once ready. :slightly_smiling_face:
